title: Laminar: Infrastructure for laminar stacking (default: honeycomb symmetry, JAM notation)
description: Laminar is a Rust workspace for the exact enumeration, canonicalization, classification, and export of stacking configurations in honeycomb layered materials. v0.1 implements the full core: parser for all 8 canonical JAM options, O(k) canonicalization (constant 2), canonical augmentation (isomorph-free, one representative per orbit), structural cell classification (four cells), ReferenceCell + CIF export, CLI (sandwich, compare, modules), Python bindings (PyO3), and config loading. Validated against published tables (37/37 counts) and against pymatgen (12/12 cases, no over-counting). 138 tests (121 Rust + 17 Python). Licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.
